literacy.prompt: Which word means the opposite of 'frugal'?
literacy.explanation: 'Lavish' means spending or giving generously — the opposite of frugal.

verbal.prompt: Which word does not belong with the others?
verbal.explanation: Painting is a visual art — the others are all musical instruments.

critical.prompt: "Every athlete on the team trains daily, so anyone who trains daily must be an athlete on the team." What's the flaw in this reasoning?
options: It assumes the reverse of a true statement is also true
It uses a word with two different meanings
It relies on an unnamed expert
It attacks the person instead of the argument
critical.explanation: "All A are B" doesn't mean "all B are A" — plenty of people who train daily aren't on the team.
